name: Company Agent Self-Improvement Loop
purpose: Turn bounded, reviewed evidence into durable agent learning without granting production authority.

steps.action: Recall relevant agent memory and prior decisions before planning.
Declare task intent, non-goals, dependencies, authority, isolation, rollback, and measurable acceptance.
Execute one bounded job within the manifest write authority and approval boundary.
Collect command results, changed files, runtime observations, and environment-gated skips.
Receive an independent reviewer, test, CI, or quality signal; the implementer is not the sole reviewer.
Mint a structured PENDING_APPROVAL THINK token containing task, evidence, failure, correction, quality signal, and confidence metadata.
Feed the structured token metadata into DTHINK without credential or sensitive payload values.
Update the owning agent memory with the reviewed result, limitations, and source evidence.
Create at most one bounded follow-up with explicit owner, dependency, acceptance condition, and approval boundary.

forbidden: Place secrets, tokens, connection strings, or credential values in THINK or DTHINK.
Make autonomous production, deployment, destructive, authentication, tenant, or authorization changes.
Self-modify agent directives or authority without an independent review and explicit approval.
Promote a token or claim from incomplete or unverified evidence.
